basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old based in Portland, Oregon, with a passion for collecting vintage coins and vinyl records. By day, I work as a graphic designer for a local advertising agency. I'm single and enjoy spending weekends exploring local flea markets and record stores. I'm also an avid gamer and spend most evenings on my Nintendo Switch. I typically browse Reddit during lunch breaks and late at night.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, which has fueled my interest in design and aesthetics. My knowledge of coin collecting comes from years of self-study and participation in online forums and local collector meetups. I stay informed about community policies through regular reading of updates from Reddit and participating in mod discussions.
